title: Granite CMS — Solid foundations for client sites

settings.heading: Solid foundations for client sites.
settings.subheading: Granite CMS is a lightweight, developer-first CMS built for agencies and freelancers who'd rather ship clean git-based sites than fight plugin bloat. Model your content, hand off a client-friendly admin, deploy anywhere.
settings.codeSnippet:
$ npx granite create acme-corp
✔ Scaffolded theme, content and vhost
✔ Structured content models ready

$ granite deploy
✔ Built 42 pages in 380ms
✔ Synced to production — done.

settings.label: Trusted by agencies and developers shipping client sites every week

settings.heading: Everything a client site needs. Nothing it doesn't.
settings.subheading: Granite is built around a small set of clean primitives instead of a decade of accumulated core and plugin cruft.

settings.heading: Structured content modelling
settings.description: Define content types with plain JSON Schema — no proprietary field builder, no black-box data model. What you write is what gets validated.

settings.heading: Git-based workflows
settings.description: Content and theme live in git alongside your code. Branch a client's homepage redesign, review it in a PR, merge it like anything else you ship.

settings.heading: Blazing performance
settings.description: No ORM, no plugin queue, no admin-panel tax on the front end. Pages render in milliseconds because there's nothing extra in the way.

settings.heading: No plugin bloat
settings.description: There's no plugin marketplace to get lost in. Granite ships with exactly what a client site needs, and nothing you'll spend a weekend patching.

settings.heading: Simple, client-friendly admin
settings.description: Hand off access without a training session. Clients edit their own copy and images through a focused admin UI — no theme settings to break.

settings.heading: Fully self-hosted and portable
settings.description: Run it on your own infrastructure or the client's. Every site is a folder of files — move it, back it up, or migrate it without asking permission.

settings.heading: From new client to live site in three steps
settings.subheading: No scaffolding to hand-roll and no framework decisions to relitigate for every new engagement.

settings.heading: Scaffold a site
settings.description: Run one command to generate a new site: theme folder, content structure and a vhost ready to deploy. No boilerplate to copy from your last project.

settings.heading: Model your content
settings.description: Define sections and blocks as plain templates with a JSON Schema for their settings. Content authors get a clean admin; you get a system you actually understand.

settings.heading: Deploy anywhere
settings.description: Granite is just a process and a folder of files. Ship it to a VPS, a container, or the client's own hosting — there's no vendor lock-in.

settings.heading: Questions agencies ask before switching
settings.subheading: If you don't see yours here, the docs cover the rest.

settings.question: Do I need to host it myself?
settings.answer: No — Granite runs anywhere Node.js does, including most managed platforms, but self-hosting is fully supported and often the whole point. Bring your own VPS, container platform, or hand it to your client's existing host.

settings.question: Can I migrate an existing WordPress site?
settings.answer: Yes. Granite includes a WordPress import script that pulls posts, pages and media into structured content JSON. Most agencies remap templates by hand afterward, since a Granite theme has a much smaller surface than a WordPress theme.

settings.question: How do clients access their site?
settings.answer: Each site ships with a lightweight, focused admin UI scoped to content — no theme settings, no plugin screens. You control what's editable per content type, so clients can't break the layout.

settings.question: How do updates work?
settings.answer: Granite has one small core and no plugin ecosystem to keep in sync, so updates are a single version bump with a changelog you can actually read in a minute.

settings.question: What if I need help?
settings.answer: Solo and Agency plans include community and priority support respectively; Enterprise gets a dedicated support channel. The docs also cover the vast majority of setup and theming questions directly.

settings.heading: Ready to build on solid ground?
settings.subheading: Scaffold your first Granite site in under five minutes. No credit card, no plugin marketplace, no legacy baggage.
